level_1.title: Level 1: Shallow Clifford Core
level_1.description: 3-qubit GHZ entangler. Learn how spacetime checks catch simple bit and phase errors.

level_2.title: Level 2: Medium Clifford Entanglement
level_2.description: 4-qubit stabilizer circuit with CNOT ladders. Identify high-crosstalk channels.

level_3.title: Level 3: Wide Clifford Lattice
level_3.description: 5-qubit lattice entangler. Balancing check count against gate overhead becomes critical.

level_4.title: Level 4: Deep Clifford Gauntlet
level_4.description: 6-qubit deep circuit. High thermal relaxation noise requires targeted spacetime placement.

level_5.title: Level 5: High-Volume Clifford Stress Test
level_5.description: 7-qubit dense Clifford network. Over-checking will rapidly destroy shot retention.

level_6.title: Level 6: Light T-Doping Injection
level_6.description: Non-Clifford T-gates introduced. Place manual Z-checks on commuting qubit channels.

level_7.title: Level 7: Moderate T-Doped Subroutine
level_7.description: 4 qubits with 4 T-gates. Target noisy bit-flip channels without disturbing phase coherence.

level_8.title: Level 8: Dense T-State Circuit
level_8.description: 5 qubits with 7 T-gates disrupting Clifford symmetry. Strategic Z-parity checks are required.

level_9.title: Level 9: High-Density Non-Clifford Gauntlet
level_9.description: 6 qubits, depth 14, 10 T-gates. Severe error accumulation across T-gate layers.

level_10.title: Level 10: Universal Fault-Tolerance Extreme Test
level_10.description: 7-qubit extreme test with 15 T-gates. Precise Z-check placement is required to hit target score.
